An ATA certified translator is an expert in the field of document translation. The certification ensures that the translated documents will be accurate and free of errors. But we have other reasons to show you why hiring an ATA Certified Transltor like American Education and Translation Services is important.

1. They Have Expertise

A certified translator has been trained by the American Translators Association (ATA) to translate documents into other languages. This means that they have expertise in the field of document translations like birth certificate, degree certificate and diploma, marriage certificate and more.

2. They Are Highly Skilled

Certified translators are highly skilled professionals with years of experience in their field. They have gone through rigorous training programs and passed certification tests to prove their skills.

American Education and Translation Services has been an ATA business member since 2009. Our certified translators are trained with the high standard of ATA, aiming to be highly skilled in their field.

3. They Will Deliver Quality Work

A good translation service will deliver high quality work at a reasonable price.

With American Eduation and Translation Services, you will have quality work with affordable pricing. Our ATA certified transltaions start from $50 and deliver the translated documents to you in a rapid speed.

Contact us if you are in need.

4. You Can Save Money by Outsourcing Translation Services

If you need to translate a document into multiple languages, you might consider outsourcing the task to a company that offers translation services. This type of service allows you to save money because you only pay for the translations that you actually use.

If you’re looking for a reliable translation service, look no further than American Education and Translation Services. We offer high quality translations at affordable prices. Our translators are experts in their fields, which means our clients receive accurate translations every time.
